description: This PHP source file defines the LanguageHelper class, which provides utility functions for handling language translation strings, language groups, and language data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for reading language strings from YAML files, managing language records in the database, and creating/deleting test language packs.

classes.name: LanguageHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing internationalization language strings, groups, and languages, including reading from YAML, database operations, and test language pack creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LanguageHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Protected method that returns the current database connection.

methods.name: readLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and associates them with a group ID.

methods.name: getGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a language group by its name, caching results.

methods.name: deleteLangStringByUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language strings by their unit ID, optionally filtered by group ID.

methods.name: insertTranslation
methods.description: Inserts or updates a translation for a specific language string.

methods.name: getLanguageIdByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves the language ID associated with a language code.

methods.name: updateLanguageStatusByLangCode
methods.description: Enables or disables a language identified by its language code.

methods.name: createTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Creates a test language pack by enabling a temporary language and adding translations.

methods.name: deleteTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Removes the test language pack and disables it.
